correctness.rationale: Independent generalized Petersen reconstruction yielded exactly 60 perfect matchings and complete face counts for 44281 nonempty simplices. Acyclic greedy Morse matching produced 22113 pairs, critical cells one 0-cell, 42 3-cells and 12 4-cells, with an exhaustive Hasse DAG test on all 44281 nonempty faces. Fresh signed gradient-path boundary calculation gave a 42x12 integer matrix with 64 nonzero entries, eleven unit Smith factors and zero residual. The 3-skeleton is wedge^42 S3 and pi_3=Z^42; eleven unit four-cell attachments cancel, leaving wedge^31 S3 vee S4. Finite integral homotopy conclusion follows without relying on only Betti numbers or logs.
